messages:
Diego Ramos: FYI AcmeCorp reported a regression after today's rollout — same prompt in the same session returned contradictory policy answers. attaching traces. :rotating_light:
Priya Patel: thanks. do we have request ids / traces?
Diego Ramos: root thread ts 1774509001. sample requests use session_id=session_acme_42. traces tr_8f3b and tr_8f3c.
Diego Ramos: prompt used:
```
"Summarize the user's policy: can they share client data with third parties?"
```
Diego Ramos: tr_8f3b -> "No, client data is confidential and cannot be shared." (correct). tr_8f3c -> "Yes, allowed if anonymized and contracted." (unexpected).
Priya Patel: customer says started right after canary->prod. P1 ticket opened. CS asked for pin but hosted customers can't self-pin.
Maya Khatri: @eng-runtime did routing/fallback change? we recently turned on variant-based fallback for throughput.
Jonas Reed: looks like both used model redwood/turbo-13b but different variants. headers:
```
Request-ID: tr_8f3b
X-Model: redwood/turbo-13b
X-Model-Variant: baseline-fp16
Routing-Policy: region=us-west;tier=hosted
Session-ID: session_acme_42
```
```
Request-ID: tr_8f3c
X-Model: redwood/turbo-13b
X-Model-Variant: speed-4bit-q
Routing-Policy: region=us-west;tier=hosted
Session-ID: session_acme_42
```
Jonas Reed: looks like autoscaling bumped traffic to speed-4bit-q mid-session -> semantic drift.
Priya Patel: AcmeCorp's downstream logic depends on deterministic "Yes/No". inconsistent outputs break their flow. they want mitigation + repro + rollback.
Diego Ramos: can we reproduce? I can replay with same session header.
Jonas Reed: repro I ran:
1) set X-Session-ID: session_acme_42
2) call hosted endpoint with the prompt
3) throttle baseline pool to force fallback
curl example:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -H "X-Session-ID: session_acme_42" \
  -H "X-Routing-Region: us-west" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood/turbo-13b","input":"Summarize the user's policy: can they share client data with third parties?"}'
```
Jonas Reed: toggling baseline capacity caused variant flips; reproduced differing answers ~60% of trials.
Priya Patel: mitigation options?
Jonas Reed: immediate choices:
- apply per-customer routing override to baseline-fp16
- disable variant fallback globally (throughput hit)
- add prompt-level semantic checks (longer term)
Jonas Reed: I'll push per-customer override; need support approval.
Priya Patel: please do and give an ETA for customer.
Jonas Reed: ETA 30-45m to apply override and smoke test. I'll add a response log tag X-Forced-Variant: baseline-fp16.
Diego Ramos: creating dashboard filter for session_acme_42 and variant diffs.
Eng-Deploy-Bot: Canary rollout to 20% for release/2026-03-15 completed at 1774506000.
Maya Khatri: likely tied to today's canary.
Jonas Reed: hypothesis: quantized variant speed-4bit-q alters conditioning (tokenization or attention kernel) causing polarity flips for constrained policy prompts. need cross-variant evals.
Priya Patel: customer update: they want confirmed timestamp when pin applied.
Jonas Reed: pin applied at 1774509087. smoke test: 20 requests all returned "No". logs tagged X-Forced-Variant: baseline-fp16.
Priya Patel: informed customer; they want postmortem.
Maya Khatri: assign postmortem owner. Jonas lead, Diego support.
Jonas Reed: action items for eng-runtime:
- add prefer-stable-variant flag for sessions
- run regression eval across prod prompt set
- alert when same session sees multiple variants within 15m
Product:
- update rollout checklist to include customer-critical prompt evals before enabling fallback
- surface per-tenant fallback controls in Console
Diego Ramos: I'll export tr_8f3b, tr_8f3c, pinned traces for postmortem. drafting short customer note now.
Support-Bot: Ticket REDW-2319 updated: mitigation applied; PM/Eng notified.
Diego Ramos: customer note draft:
```
Hi AcmeCorp,
We identified that some of your requests were routed to a quantized model variant during today's rollout which can produce different phrasing/semantics for tightly constrained policy prompts. We've pinned your traffic to the baseline-fp16 variant while we investigate. ETA for postmortem: 48-72 hours. Apologies for the disruption.
— Diego, Customer Ops
```
Priya Patel: closing loop in ticket; will attach postmortem when ready.
Maya Khatri: keep PM/Legal in loop for SLA implications. :thumbsup:
Diego Ramos: archiving thread after postmortem doc created.
